identity.name: Promethius
identity.archetype: Archetype 5: Luxury & Archetype 4: Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid
identity.vibe: Elite, powerful, mysterious, architectural. The bringer of fire/knowledge.

background.description: Deep obsidian/void. Never pure black #000000, tinted slightly with warm/cool tones depending on lighting.

accent.description: The 'Ember' representing Promethius' fire. Used very sparingly for voice active states, key CTAs, and AI response indicators.

rules.h1: font-heading text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tighter text-zinc-50 font-medium

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous negative space. Elements should feel like they are floating in a void, anchored by precise 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar_left: w-72 border-r border-white/5 bg-[#09090b] flex flex-col
spacing_and_layout.sidebar_right: w-80 border-l border-white/5 bg-[#09090b]/50 backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col
spacing_and_layout.chat_container: flex-1 flex flex-col max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full pt-8 pb-32 px-4 md:px-8

chat_input_bar.layout: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-3xl px-4 z-50
chat_input_bar.styling: flex items-end gap-2 bg-[#121214]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-2 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 focus-within:border-orange-500/30 focus-within:shadow-[0_8px_40px_rgba(234,88,12,0.1)]
chat_input_bar.input_field: w-full bg-transparent border-none text-zinc-50 placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:ring-0 resize-none py-3 px-4 min-h-[52px] max-h-[200px] font-body
chat_input_bar.voice_button: h-12 w-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 bg-[#1c1c1f] hover:bg-[#27272a] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-50 border border-white/5 transition-colors relative
chat_input_bar.voice_button_active: bg-gradient-to-tr from-orange-600 to-amber-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(234,88,12,0.4)] animate-pulse

chat_messages.user_bubble: max-w-[80%] ml-auto bg-[#1c1c1f] border border-white/5 text-zinc-100 rounded-3xl rounded-tr-md px-6 py-4 font-body shadow-sm
chat_messages.ai_bubble: max-w-[90%] mr-auto text-zinc-200 py-4 font-body leading-relaxed flex gap-6
chat_messages.ai_avatar: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-orange-500
chat_messages.streaming_indicator: inline-block w-2 h-4 bg-orange-500 animate-pulse ml-1

model_selector.trigger: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#121214] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer
model_selector.dropdown: bg-[#121214] border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-xl

memory_panel.card: bg-[#121214] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all group
memory_panel.fact_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-white/5 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-mono border border-white/5

knowledge_vault.upload_zone: border-2 border-dashed border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center hover:border-orange-500/30 hover:bg-orange-500/5 transition-colors cursor-pointer
knowledge_vault.file_item: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-transparent hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

data_attributes.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Kebab-case, role-based.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Elements should gently lighten (bg-white/5) on hover. Borders transition from white/5 to white/10.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade and slide up for lists (Memories, Files, Tasks).
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use aria-hidden on purely decorative visual elements.

login_background.description: Illuminated dust particles in a dark void. Represents the 'spark' of Promethius in the darkness.

empty_state_texture.description: Dark atmospheric texture. Use at 10% opacity as an absolute background layer in empty chat states to prevent flatness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use default Tailwind blue or generic grays. Use the specified zinc and orange hexes.
Implement the Chat Input Bar as a floating element (`fixed bottom-8`), NOT attached to the bottom edge of the screen.
Use Lucide-React icons but override the stroke width to 1.5 for a finer, more elegant look.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Dialogs, Selects, Dropdowns) are stripped of their default light-mode shadows and given the dark glassmorphism styling defined in 'surface.glass'.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable button, input, and list item.
